messages:
Alyssa: quick heads-up — I opened a tiny PR to tidy up wording in the SDK examples. swapped 'embedding vector' -> 'embedding' and changed example model handle from 'RedwoodOpt' to 'redwood-optimized'. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/345
Priya: 👍 on using 'embedding' in user-facing docs. can we add a glossary alias so search/find still matches 'vector'? some customers still say vector.
Ben: +1. keep 'vector' as a technical alias (infra/benchmarks) but use 'embedding' everywhere in the SDK examples and quickstarts. also: is the model handle casing deliberate? we have a mix of kebab-case and camel in examples.
Samir: we try to use param-style in code samples (kebab or snake depending on SDK). UI copy prefers plain words. See the style guide snippet: https://redwood.company/docs/style/sdk-naming
Alyssa: to be concrete — current PR shows code like:
```
client.generate(
  model="redwood-optimized-1",
  input="Summarize this..."
)
```
so I'm using kebab-case for model handles and plain 'model family' in prose. Is that ok?
Priya: that snippet looks good. rule proposal: code + API params = literal identifiers (kebab/snake), prose = lowercase phrase ("model family", "embedding"). I'll add a glossary entry: embedding -> vector (alias).
Ben: can we add a short line in the glossary that says 'embedding (aka vector) — prefer "embedding" in docs; keep "vector" for infra/benchmarks'? helps reviewers. I'll batch that with a quick link fix PR.
docs-bot: reminder — docs-glossary.yml needs an anchor for 'embedding' to surface in the in-site search. I've queued an issue: #812.
Samir: one more nit: in SDK comments we currently have 'ModelFamily' in camel; prefer param_case or kebab depending on language. let's make a follow-up checklist item so this PR stays small. @Alyssa can you add a one-liner in the PR description noting the follow-up?
Alyssa: done — added "follow-up: normalize SDK param casing (separate PR)" to the PR description. moving this to reviewers now. thanks all :tada:
